weaknesses.title: Empty needle: COUNTINFILES→0 but FIRSTFILE/LASTFILE→first/last readable
weaknesses.detail: Documented in op comments; still a live footgun. Agent that forgets ARG1 gets a confident path pick from FIRSTFILE while tally correctly reports zero. Opposite of REPLACEFILES empty-old silent skip — here pick is affirmative OK=1 N=1.
weaknesses.repro: FIRSTFILE bag "" → LAST=first path OK=1; COUNTINFILES bag "" → 0

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON multiline bag collapses to single glued string
weaknesses.detail: TALLY plate is newline KV but PRINT_JSON tally prints needlesk_live_hits2files1… Same class as prior REALWORLD. Agents cannot round-trip plate bags via JSON line.

weaknesses.title: FIRST/LASTFILE bookends are bag order not mtime/path sort
weaknesses.detail: PATHGLOB order is filesystem/readdir dependent. 'Blast entry/exit' semantics agents want usually need SORTMTIME or SORT paths first. FIRSTFILE early-stop SCAN makes order doubly load-bearing.
weaknesses.repro: same files different PATHS line order → different FIRST

weaknesses.title: GREPFILES returns paths; COUNTINFILES returns totals only
weaknesses.detail: No COUNTINFILES path bag of infected files. Agents need dual call GREPFILES + COUNTINFILES for list+severity. COUNTINFILES_FILES is a count not a bag.
weaknesses.repro: tally files=2 vs hits action path list

weaknesses.title: Substring match has no word-boundary / token mode
weaknesses.detail: sk_live matches sk_live_AAA and sk_liveX. Security token boards need exact/prefix/regex which language lacks on file ops. Prefixing underscore is agent discipline only.

weaknesses.title: Content-only: path basenames never searched
weaknesses.detail: File sk_live_name_only.log with content 'nothing' scores 0 for needle sk_live_name. Filename leaks invisible to COUNTINFILES/FIRSTFILE.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits trailing NL on single-path plates
weaknesses.detail: FIRST.txt / last line of PATHS often no final $ on cat -A. Recurring WRITE NL gap.

weaknesses.title: SYS NUM on non-numeric REQUIRE env leaves REQUIRE_HIT=0 silently
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_TB_REQUIRE=abc → OK=0 on NUM, flag stays default 0 so miss soft-succeeds. Easy to think REQUIRE was on.

workarounds: Reject blank needle at agent layer before FIRSTFILE (this board EXIT 2)
SORTMTIME or SORT paths before span for temporal bookends
Use longest unique token prefix (sk_live_) not short false friends
SYS NUM + require OK or explicit digit check for REQUIRE env
Do not trust PRINT_JSON for multiline plates — READ plate files
language_gaps: FIRSTFILE empty needle should miss like COUNTINFILES (or both refuse)
COUNTINFILES return infected path bag (or HITFILES)
Optional basename/path match for needle boards
PRINT_JSON bag-as-array; WRITE trailing NL option
FIRSTFILE by mtime not only bag order
issues_faced: Empty needle asymmetry confirmed outside agent guard
PRINT_JSON tally glue surprises still present
PATHGLOB order non-deterministic for bookend semantics
